title: Menstrualome aids difficult endometriosis diagnosis - Nature Biotechnology
text:
From circulating microRNAs to menstrual-fluid transcriptomics, biotech companies are betting on radically different biomarkers to detect a disease that still lacks a clear molecular definition.
